summary: Targeted iter25 backend+frontend retest executed. Backend regression passed for ready/unpaid lock, inline payment methods (Tunai/E-Money), completion after paid, and kasbon selected-date persistence. Frontend pegawai flow passed for inline Bayar Sekarang and payment-to-Sudah Diambil transition, but owner kasbon calendar interaction showed unstable behavior across reruns.

ui_bugs.issue: Kasbon date picker interaction was unstable in mobile web replay (element reported outside viewport in one run; in another run payroll list became empty with 'Belum ada pegawai').

integration_issues.issue: Intermittent empty payroll state seen on /gaji despite owner logged in; likely outlet-state sync/query timing issue.

action_items: Investigate owner payroll empty-state intermittency on Gaji tab (outlet/query synchronization).
Stabilize Kasbon date-picker modal interaction on small mobile viewport so calendar is always tappable.
Keep inline ready-payment card behavior as implemented; pegawai flow for unpaid->paid->Sudah Diambil is working.
QRIS gateway remains MOCKED/manual confirmation; keep option visible but treat gateway status separately.
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/src/api.ts still hardcodes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL instead of expected EXPO_BACKEND_URL convention from project rules.
frontend/app/(owner)/gaji.tsx uses local outletId state with OutletSwitcher global state, creating potential stale/empty query states when outlet context changes.

success_rate.frontend: 75% (pegawai inline payment flow passed; owner kasbon calendar flow unstable)

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_iter25_ui customer and two ready orders (unpaid+paid) via /app/tests/iter25_ui_seed.py. Cleanup completed via /app/tests/iter25_ui_cleanup.py (orders, work_logs, transactions, order_items, kasbon test notes, and customers).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Credentials were read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md before auth tests. Verified pegawai flow: ready unpaid card shows lock warning, Bayar Sekarang opens inline card with Tunai/QRIS/E-Money/JW Coin, E-Money payment updates /api/orders/{id} payment_status=paid, then Sudah Diambil works. Owner Gaji compact text validation passed (Bonus Cuci + Bonus Setrika; forbidden stage labels absent), but kasbon calendar interaction became unstable due viewport/empty payroll state in reruns.
rca_of_issue: Reproduction: owner login -> Gaji -> expand pegawai -> Catat Kasbon. In one run kasbon-date-picker existed but Playwright reported outside viewport; in another run list switched to empty ('Belum ada pegawai'). Potential RCA is state sync between OutletSwitcher/session outlet and local outletId query dependency plus mobile sheet layout constraints causing tap target to fall outside visible/tappable region under certain render states.
